svg.title: PathwayIQ data flow — quiz request end to end
svg.desc: Step by step data flow from student quiz submission through Cloudflare, AWS Lambda, R2, back to browser

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What quiz questions does PathwayIQ ask?')
sendPrompt('How does api-client.ts call the backend?')
sendPrompt('What data is in careers.json on R2?')
sendPrompt('How are careers ranked and labelled?')
sendPrompt('How is AI risk score used in matching?')
sendPrompt('How are career cards rendered in the browser?')
sendPrompt('What does the student see after the quiz?')
sendPrompt('How does the PDF download start?')
sendPrompt('How is the report request sent?')
sendPrompt('What data goes into the PDF report?')
sendPrompt('How is the PDF generated with react-pdf?')
sendPrompt('How does the PDF reach the student?')
sendPrompt('What is in the PathwayIQ PDF report?')

svg.text: react-pdf needs Node.js — cannot run on CF Workers
